content_html:
Buying a refurbished Apple Watch can be a good way to save money, but the best choice depends on how much you care about battery life, screen size, health features and how long you want the watch to stay useful.

Some links in this article are affiliate links. We may earn a commission if you make a purchase.

Refurbished Apple Watch: check pairing, battery and account removal

Start with the iPhone you will pair

Confirm the watch model, generation and current iPhone/iOS requirements in Apple's support information before choosing by case size. GPS and cellular variants have different requirements; mobile service also needs a compatible plan if you want to use that feature away from the phone. Do not infer UK carrier support from a cellular label on an imported offer.

Ask for a usable watch, not only a cosmetic grade

Check battery-health information, Activation Lock removal and the included charging equipment. Confirm the case and strap dimensions against what you intend to wear. During the return period, follow Apple's setup instructions to test pairing, charging, screen response and the functions you need. A seller-refurbished grade is not automatically Apple Certified Refurbished, and fitness features do not make a watch a substitute for medical assessment.

Apple Watch Series 9 - best all-round choice

The Series 9 is a strong place to start if you want a relatively recent model without paying current-generation prices. It offers a bright display, fast performance and a broad set of everyday fitness and health features.

Check current refurbished Apple Watch Series 9 listings on eBay UK

Apple Watch Series 8 - best value alternative

The Series 8 can be especially attractive when it is noticeably cheaper than the Series 9. It remains a capable smartwatch for notifications, workouts and general daily use.

Check current refurbished Apple Watch Series 8 listings on eBay UK

Apple Watch SE 2nd generation - best budget option

The second-generation SE is a sensible choice if you mainly want core Apple Watch features and are less concerned about the more advanced sensors found on higher-end models.

Check current refurbished Apple Watch SE listings on eBay UK

Apple Watch Ultra - best for a larger rugged watch

The original Apple Watch Ultra can be worth comparing if you prefer a larger display, longer battery life and a more rugged design. Refurbished examples can cost substantially less than buying a new Ultra model.

Check current refurbished Apple Watch Ultra listings on eBay UK

What to check before buying

Check the case size, GPS or Cellular version, cosmetic condition, battery information, seller feedback, returns policy and warranty. Also make sure Activation Lock has been removed and that the watch is compatible with the iPhone you intend to use.

Our pick

For most buyers, the Series 9 is the first model we would compare. If the Series 8 is meaningfully cheaper, it can be an excellent value alternative, while the SE is the better choice for keeping costs down.

Prices, promotions and availability change regularly, so always check the live listing before purchasing.
